project.name: Lyraform
project.summary: Experimental graph-, contract-, and flow-oriented language and system-architecture project, formerly Flowcore

current_milestone.name: Reusable native Lyraform compiler chain
current_milestone.result: The reusable chain is verified for its admitted bounded surface: installed compiler tools compile newly supported source, exact evidence authorization and native/TinyVM boundary behavior pass; broader language and backend parity remain unfinished.

verified_capabilities: Deterministic and independently validated TinyVM executable artifacts
Equivalent portable switch and GCC calculated-goto TinyVM engines
Shared captured backend-neutral lowering consumed by LLVM and TinyVM
Provider-free scalar execution parity for the currently admitted surface
Exact governed host-call admission with unsupported tuples inventoried
Name-only llvm-host and tinyvm-portable target-policy builds without implicit fallback
One shared tokenizer/document scalar classifier executed through LLVM and both TinyVM engines
Validated dependency graph for remaining Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 bootstrap work
Exact generated contract and live-provider evidence authorization
Native scalar source graphs with runtime-owned deterministic activation-record FIFO and fresh receiver frames
Flow-owned paging with injectable batch input, terminal and output providers
Installed newly named gettid acceptance with unchanged compiler binaries
Verified packed integer aggregate payloads and bounded aggregate streams through LLVM and TinyVM
TinyVM ISA 2 graph activation metadata with switch/computed trace parity
Deterministic TinyVM graph activation-record budgets with switch/computed refusal parity
Bounded TinyVM graph activation FIFO with switch/computed order and drain parity
Fail-closed trust admission that prevents isolation claim text from authorizing execution without an admitted enforcement provider

Canonical Flowmini, TinyVM v1/v2, and LLVM file-artifact publication with parent-directory synchronization, explicit published-but-durability-uncertain results, and next-run cleanup after abrupt process death
Executable inventory of all six canonical native production source files with direct file-write authority

Exact fail-closed scheduling admission across semantic/execution/source-graph artifacts, graph-provider maps, optimizer ingress, and Flowparallel planning/provider boundaries, guarded by an executable authority inventory
Canonical guard and disposition facts with fail-closed dangling-wire refusal and format-correct hostile validation
Bounded Outcome<Text,TextFailure> accounting with success-only payload access and exactly-once cleanup
Uniform unique owned-obligation transfer through one direct return or one bounded forwarding owner across LLVM and TinyVM
Exact callable-plan-v2 semantic authority envelope preserved and revalidated through execution planning, optimization, backend preparation, LLVM, and TinyVM
Executable whole-language audit classifies every current typed source kind and captured graph family without expanding language meaning
Declarative closed-set failure consumers accept canonical failure-envelope projections and constrain policy to exact ordinary function identities without authorizing runtime routing
Bounded evidence-epoch law requires proven closure before compaction and forbids silent truncation at policy limits

verification.clang_superbuild: fresh Clang 18.1.3 ASan/UBSan failure-consumer build and focused test pass; prior full debug canonical suite pass retained in its dated checkpoint
verification.gcc_asan_ubsan: Stage 4B hostile authority-preservation route passes with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer; leak detection disabled because of the host ptrace wrapper
verification.valgrind: Stage 4B carrying consumers and the final failure-consumer contract are clean with zero errors and zero outstanding bytes

explicit_non_claims: Arbitrary target architectures are not implemented
Native graph execution covers the verified Point aggregate and bounded streams; broader aggregate/runtime activation semantics remain open
The pager renders after a bounded input batch, not continuously
Provider evidence is checked at binding time and does not pin future loads
No isolation enforcement provider is implemented or wired to execution consumers
